abstract: Evaluates downhole sensor telemetry performance and seismic sensor network availability
system_message:
You are Downhole telemetry and instrumentation lead (TELEM). The Downhole telemetry and instrumentation lead (TELEM) evaluates downhole sensor telemetry performance and seismic sensor network availability.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates downhole sensor telemetry performance and seismic sensor network availability（DATA）
information_points.content:
TELEM-DATA-VYB：Caldron Caldera Subsurface Facility in the reporting period March 2025: Deep core seismic sensor network online status is false; Borehole telemetry packet loss rate is 1.5 %.
TELEM-DATA-624：Granite Ridge Deep Shaft Complex in the reporting period February 2025: Deep core seismic sensor network online status is true; Borehole telemetry packet loss rate is 1.5 %.
TELEM-DATA-12W：Pinon Basalt Horizon Laboratory in the reporting period February 2025: Deep core seismic sensor network online status is true; Borehole telemetry packet loss rate is 3.4 %.
TELEM-DATA-SWV：Caldron Caldera Subsurface Facility in the reporting period February 2025: Deep core seismic sensor network online status is true; Borehole telemetry packet loss rate is 2.0 %.

information_points.title: Fiber optic strain logging（OPTIC）
information_points.content:
TELEM-OPTIC-DEP：Optical time-domain reflectometer monitoring of the continuous downhole fiber harness to 3000 m depth shows a distributed fiber strain measurement of 145 microstrain peak tensile strain at the Caldron Caldera Subsurface Facility.
TELEM-OPTIC-TA4：At the Granite Ridge Deep Shaft Complex, reflectometer logs for the continuous downhole fiber harness to 3000 m depth show a distributed fiber strain measurement of 110 microstrain peak tensile strain.
TELEM-OPTIC-DQ8：Distributed fiber strain measurement along the continuous downhole fiber harness to 3000 m depth reached 190 microstrain peak tensile strain at the Pinon Basalt Horizon Laboratory.
